subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood walkthrough — conflict with prospect travel

To: Samantha Rivera <samantha@averylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood walkthrough — proposed 16 May

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to lock in a 30–45 minute walkthrough of Redwood with the core stakeholders so we can cover:
- Short overview of runtime and deployment modes
- How Dedicated/Private would map to Avery's compliance needs
- Cost/latency tradeoffs and a short Q&A

Would 16 May at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET work for you and the team? I attached a short deck to orient anyone joining for the first time. If that slot is tight, I can propose two alternate windows.

Agenda is intentionally light — happy to add any integration questions you want Monica (CC'd) to prepare for.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | 415-555-0189
Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (slides, 8 pages)
From: Samantha Rivera <samantha@averylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — proposed 16 May

Hi Sean —

Thanks — I appreciate the agenda. Unfortunately I'm traveling to three customer sites the week of May 16 and will be in the field May 15–20 with very limited connectivity. I need to reschedule.

Two options from my side:
1) Move to the week of May 22 (best: May 22–24) — I can do mornings ET most days.
2) If you need to talk earlier, we could do a short virtual call this Thursday 5/14 in the afternoon ET, but it would be a compressed 20-min slot.

Also, please include our IT lead on the invite — she'll want to validate firewall/KMS questions. Attaching my travel itinerary so you can see the constraint.

Sorry for the change — we still want the walkthrough, just want to make sure the right folks can join.

Best,
Samantha Rivera
Head of Product Operations | Avery Labs
samantha@averylabs.com
Attachment: avery-itinerary.pdf

Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — proposed 16 May

Samantha —

Totally understand, thanks for the heads up and for sending the itinerary.

Two proposals that keep Monica and your IT lead in scope:
- Option A: Friday, May 22 at 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT — 45 minutes (covers integration checklist)
- Option B: Monday, May 25 at 2:00 PM PT / 5:00 PM ET — 30–45 minutes (more flexible for your schedule)

If you prefer a quick stand-in this Thursday (5/14), we can do a 20-minute sync and then run the full walkthrough after you're back.

I've looped in Monica from our CS team to prep the integration checklist and firewall/KMS notes — Monica, can you have a short pre-read (1 page) ready for the call?

I'll hold both tentative slots in my calendar and send an updated invite once you confirm. Attaching the updated invite stub.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: updated-invite.ics

Option A (May 22 at 11:00 AM ET) works for me and I've asked our IT lead (Maya Chen) to join. Confirming that time now. Please send the calendar invite and the 1-page integration pre-read so IT can scan ahead.

Also, can you include a short note in the invite about expected attendees from Redwood and the key questions we'll cover? That helps my team prioritize.

See you then — safe travels in the meantime.
